description: Wait for a SceneGraph field to change (or match a specific value) via RTA onFieldChangeOnce. Returns when the observer fires or the timeout elapses. Great for "wait until video starts playing" style assertions.

field.description: Field name to observe (used with nodeId)

host.description: IP address or hostname of the Roku device

match.description: Optional value to wait for. If omitted, fires on any change.

nodeId.description: uiElementId or scene id of the node

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait before giving up (default 10000)

name: roku_observe_field
